claims.title: Build the ramp bonus
claims.body: Shoot the left ramp. This qualifies the ramp bonus and gives you a repeatable scoring route.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Collect the ramp bonus
claims.body: Shoot the right ramp. The left ramp has qualified this bonus; the right ramp collects it.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Qualify a mode
claims.body: Shoot the spinner lane. This lights the mode scoop for an advanced scoring sequence.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Start a mode
claims.body: Shoot the mode scoop. Starting the mode makes the bullseye award available.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Finish the mode
claims.body: Shoot the bullseye. With the mode active, this shot collects its scoring award.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Light the lock
claims.body: Complete the drop-target bank. This lights the ball lock, the first step toward multiball.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Lock the first ball
claims.body: Shoot the lit ball lock. This records your first lock toward multiball.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Lock the second ball
claims.body: Shoot the ball lock again. The second lock brings you one step closer.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Start multiball
claims.body: Shoot the ball lock for the third time. The third lock starts this demonstration machine’s multiball.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Collect a jackpot
claims.body: Shoot the left orbit. During multiball, the left orbit collects a jackpot.
claims.reviewNote: Original fictional fixture; not authentic machine content.

claims.title: Demonstration guide sequences
claims.body: Fictional demo: use ramp bonus for simple scoring, the spinner/scoop/bullseye sequence for advanced scoring, or drop targets and three locks for multiball.
